subject.title: [Bug]: Live Docs are ahead of release

question: Should OpenClaw make docs.openclaw.ai stable-release-aware, latest-with-version-badges, or rely on version-aware config diagnostics for strict config keys that are on main but not in stable?
rationale: The bug is reproducible, but the durable fix changes docs publishing, release policy, and user-facing config recovery rather than one local code path.

options.title: Gate or badge docs by stable release
options.body: Add version metadata or release checks so strict config keys are not presented to stable users without an availability warning.

options.title: Improve config diagnostics for future keys
options.body: Teach validation or doctor to recognize known newer config keys and explain the required OpenClaw version when users copy ahead-of-release docs.

options.title: Defer to bundled-docs retrieval work
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/71301 as the broader track, accepting that this live public docs drift remains until that product direction lands.

recommendation.title: Gate or badge docs by stable release
recommendation.body: Add version metadata or release checks so strict config keys are not presented to stable users without an availability warning.

likelyOwner.reason: The current drift example came through the utility-model landing, and this owner also has recent docs-sync workflow history.
